Content.default: Panel content. Keep each panel focused on one topic so people can scan the titles and open only what they need.

components.description: Expandable section. Variant = Plain (divider) | Card (filled) × Size = S (size/list-item/1) | M (size/list-item/2) × Open = Off | On × State = Default | Hover | Focus | Disabled = 32 variants. Open shows Content text and/or a Slot (exposed, swap any component). Chevron rotates 180° when open. Leading icon and Badge are exposed.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Group of Accordion items (Plain · M). Items are exposed — set Open, Style or Size per item. Show item 4–6 changes the count. Single vs multiple open: see Developer map (aria-expanded per header).
